source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_EDS_MBK_AUDITMTB WHERE H = 'D'

scripts.text:
DELETE FROM EDS.MBK_AUDITMTB WHERE AS_OF_DATE = @Datetoprocess;

INSERT INTO EDS.MBK_AUDITMTB
(
    AS_OF_DATE
,   APP_ID
,   AUDIT_DATE
,   PHONE_NO
,   ACCESS_TYPE
,   AUDIT_ACTION
,   SERVICE_INPUT
,   MERCHANT_ID
,   IP
,   AUDIT_FIELD1
,   AUDIT_FIELD2
,   AUDIT_FIELD3
,   AUDIT_FIELD4
,   AUDIT_FIELD5
,   AUDIT_FIELD6
,   AUDIT_FIELD7
,   AUDIT_FIELD8
,   AUDIT_FIELD9
,   AUDIT_FIELD10
,   ACCESS_CHANNEL
,   PRIMARYFIELD
,   SECONDARYFIELD
,   HEADERDUMP
,   GPRSPHONENO
,   ARCHIVAL_STATUS
,   STATUS
,   PHONE_MODEL
,	isActive
,	isLatest
,	BNK_CODE
,	SOURCE_CODE
,	FILE_NAME
,	insert_dttm
)

SELECT 
CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS AS_OF_DATE
,   APP_ID
,   AUDIT_DATE
,   PHONE_NO
,   ACCESS_TYPE
,   AUDIT_ACTION
,   SERVICE_INPUT
,   MERCHANT_ID
,   IP
,   AUDIT_FIELD1
,   AUDIT_FIELD2
,   AUDIT_FIELD3
,   AUDIT_FIELD4
,   AUDIT_FIELD5
,   AUDIT_FIELD6
,   AUDIT_FIELD7
,   AUDIT_FIELD8
,   AUDIT_FIELD9
,   AUDIT_FIELD10
,   ACCESS_CHANNEL
,   PRIMARYFIELD
,   SECONDARYFIELD
,   HEADERDUMP
,   GPRSPHONENO
,   ARCHIVAL_STATUS
,   STATUS
,   PHONE_MODEL
,	1 as isActive
,	1 as isLatest
,	left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
,	substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
,	FILE_NAME
,	convert(datetime2,insert_dttm) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_EDS_MBK_AUDITMTB
WHERE H = 'D'
